$description: Chart accessibility (platform/charts/a11y.js and chart-a11y.css; library wave 9, lane C): the ring around the active mark (pointer or keyboard), and the textures that tell series apart without their color (ChartPatterns). Existing roles only.

chart-keys-ring-color.$description: Chart keys: the ring around the active mark (pointer or keyboard), so it is seen without its color.

chart-keys-ring-width.$description: Chart keys: the active mark's ring width.

chart-pattern-color.$description: Chart patterns: the texture's strokes and dots, in the surface color over the mark's data color.

chart-pattern-width.$description: Chart patterns: the texture's stroke width.
